data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 食堂大份定食的满足感
data.description: 学校食堂，她面前摆着堆成小山的特大份定食，双手合十说出「我开动了」的瞬间眼睛亮得像星星；第一口下去后整个人散发出幸福气场，周围同学都侧目。
data.action: 学校食堂，她面前摆着堆成小山的特大份定食，双手合十说出「我开动了」的瞬间眼睛亮得像星星
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami brings both hands together before the towering extra-large set meal in the school canteen, eyes bright with anticipation. Her white blouse, blue bow and navy knee-length skirt stay neat as the first bite brings open delight. The medium portrait includes classmates looking over from neighboring tables. Daylight illuminates the piled food and her pleased face, with distinct tray and bowl shadows across the table surface.
